comments.value: outside of being able to check at a glance how poor that "very poor" rating really is (and judging them for that), this can have uses in club instances where avatar moderation is required. Going through the users lists one by one is a hassle and a half, maybe there could be some calculated performance number that co-exists with the performance rating (like idk, scores 1-5 are excelent, 5-10 are good, 10-20 medium, etc)

Ah yes this would make managing fps so much easier. 

And it would help with security checking things things to. Suddenly you can easily check which very poors have <100mb vram usage and really arent that bad.

details:
VRAM usage is difficult to manage, and failure to manage it effectively results in disruptive app crashes.

An option to sort the list of players in an instance by highest VRAM usage would present already-available info in a more usable way. Players could quickly choose avatars to hide to save VRAM.
title: Sort player list by VRAM usage so we know who to hide
